svg.title: Deep back muscles (trapezius and latissimus dorsi removed)
svg.desc: Explicit deep dissection, posterior view. Trapezius, latissimus dorsi and deltoid are removed on both sides. Patient right (viewer right): rhomboid minor and major, levator scapulae, supraspinatus and the intact erector spinae column. Patient left (viewer left): erector spinae also removed to expose multifidus beside the spinous processes and quadratus lumborum in the lumbar region.
